mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as lower financing costs boost corporate investment valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, restrictive monetary policy immediately dampens equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors price in tighter financial conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances, or average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in non-farm payrolls signals labor market strength that accelerates corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as economic expansion intensifies.
failure_condition: Interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05) in regression of 60-day returns on UNRATE-PAYEMS interaction term, or Rank IC for interaction signal falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, rising residential construction (HOUST) and strong consumer credit (RSAFS) signal robust household spending that drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as peak growth approaches.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods meeting HOUST > 500 and RSAFS > 340000, or Rank IC for signal falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months indicates weakening manufacturing activity that reduces corporate profit expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as growth prospects deteriorate.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO has declined for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 5-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When residential housing starts (HOUST) fall below 500 thousand units for two consecutive months, weakening housing market activity reduces consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as economic slowdown accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances, or average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS signals accelerating inflation requiring central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as equity valuations contract under higher real rates.
failure_condition: Interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05) in regression of 20-day returns on CPIAUCSL-FEDFUNDS interaction term, or Rank IC for interaction signal falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 7.0%), rising non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signal labor market recovery that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as recession transitions to expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE > 7.0 and PAYEMS increased in prior month, or Rank IC for signal falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.
